supportingDocuments.desc: Forensic analysis showing Track 2 data anomalies consistent with magnetic stripe cloning.
Evidence that the cardholder was in their home city at the time of the transaction (mobile banking login from home IP).

chargebackFiling.issuerCommentary: Filing under 4862. Transaction processed via magnetic stripe at a terminal that does not support EMV chip. The magnetic stripe data shows cloning indicators. The genuine cardholder was in a different city at the time.
